items.name: Agent colour
items.desc: The actor's colour swatch and portrait.

items.name: Copy
items.desc: Copy this position (X, Y, Z) to the clipboard

items.name: Paste XYZ
items.desc: Paste X, Y, Z from the clipboard. You can also Ctrl+V a triple straight into any X/Y/Z box.

items.name: Paste XZ
items.desc: Paste X and Z only, keeping this object's own height (Y)

items.name: Position X
items.desc: East-west position in metres.

items.name: Position Y
items.desc: Height in metres.

items.name: Position Z
items.desc: North-south position in metres.

items.name: Apply Position
items.desc: Moves the actor to the typed position.

items.name: Rotation X
items.desc: Start rotation about X, in degrees.

items.name: Rotation Y
items.desc: Start rotation about Y (turning left and right), in degrees.

items.name: Rotation Z
items.desc: Start rotation about Z, in degrees.

items.name: Copy rot
items.desc: Copies the X, Y, Z rotation to the clipboard.

items.name: Paste rot
items.desc: Pastes X, Y, Z rotation from the clipboard.

items.name: Face... (turn to face)
items.desc: Turns the actor to face another object. A flat turn about Y unless Tilt is ticked. Zero rotation faces +Z.

items.name: Tilt
items.desc: When ticked, Face also tilts up or down, not just a flat turn.

items.name: Apply Rotation
items.desc: Sets the actor's start rotation.

items.name: Avatar scale (this scene)
items.desc: Resizes the avatar in this scene only. 1 means as authored. The avatar file is not changed.

items.name: Apply Scale
items.desc: Saves the scale for this scene.

items.name: Character lights (light set)
items.desc: Key, fill and back lights that move and turn with this actor. Scene default follows the Export tab checkbox.

items.name: Key light
items.desc: Intensity of the key light.

items.name: Fill light
items.desc: Intensity of the fill light.

items.name: Back light
items.desc: Intensity of the back light.

items.name: Apply Lights
items.desc: Saves the light set for this actor.

items.name: Swap Avatar
items.desc: Replaces this actor's avatar. To assign a new H-Anim figure, use Character Creator.

items.name: Waiting pose: thinking
items.desc: Pose played while waiting for a live reply. Pick from this character's own clips. None means no change.

items.name: Waiting pose: hold
items.desc: Pose played while waiting for the user. Pick from this character's own clips. None means no change.

items.name: Remove
items.desc: Removes the actor from the scene.
